_doc: What-if change limits (Phase 6, brief P5). A requested change is BLOCKED (HTTP 422) when it
falls outside the recipe window or the physical limit of the parameter.
recipe_window = the in-spec band of the synthetic process window (app/simulator/process_physics.py
CHANNEL_SPECS center +/- half_width) - the setpoints a recipe is allowed to run at.
physical = the hardware range the synthetic generator can ever produce (center +/- 3 half-widths,
the generator's clip range) - values outside it cannot occur at all.
These are SYNTHETIC reference values, chosen to be plausible for a generic 300mm etch step.

maintenance_days_since_last.note: 0 = 'preventive maintenance done right before this lot'.

not_overridable.etch_time: Constant in the v2 synthetic data (no variation) - the model cannot respond to it.
not_overridable.voltage: Constant in the v2 synthetic data (no variation) - the model cannot respond to it.
not_overridable.current: Constant in the v2 synthetic data (no variation) - the model cannot respond to it.
